properties.name: The design says where each artifact is kept and who can reach it from where
properties.statement: Every artifact location in a design says how reachable it is: saved on the hosted server (any collaborator's chat can open it, whether claude.ai or grok.com), in a public repository (any agent anywhere can read it), or in a private repository or on one person's machine (only that machine can open it). A chat that cannot reach an implementation reports where it is being built rather than pretending to read it. From Anthony, 2026-09-25: "if the repo is private, then it is pretty much limited to my machine only, but reflow2/flo2 still need to note in the design that it is being developed on my local machine and a grok chat or claude.ai chat won't be able to reference the actual implementation - it'll just have to note where it is being implemented."
